title: Read the shadow file with a copy of cat named sudo
threat_model: An attacker names the reading program after a program that is allowed to read the file, so that a name-based allow list ignores it.
known_gap: sensitive_file_access skips readers whose comm is on its expected-reader list, and the comm is the name of the file that was run, so a copy named sudo is suppressed.
notes: setup.sh copies /bin/cat to a file named sudo in the work directory, and the action runs it by that explicit path. The name is only a file name, and nothing is run with the real sudo.
